answer: The atlas counter is kept in haven and sonnet shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 49 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 49 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3661 identities would post 1433 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
